verdict.rationale: Sentry's pricing pages document custom dashboards as a product feature at every tier (10, 20, or unlimited), so the core dashboard capability exists. The evidence never describes what those dashboards show. Missing for 10: documented error-trend or volume-over-time widgets, top-regressions views, new-issues-per-release breakdowns, cross-project/team aggregation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can see error trends across projects and teams on dashboards — top regressions, new issues per release, volume over time
